name: Simple Menu Tree
description: Provides an SDC component for rendering a menu as a tree.
project_description:
Just want to present a simple menu tree on website, and config the source which are from menu or taxonomy.

This module could be the easy one when you installed it.

There will be a module called menu tree, and place it in your region, and then config the datasource and the title, that is all.

you will see a menu tree on your web.

 Requires Drupal 10+ SDC.

 Features 
 Simply present a dynamice tree on web, and the source could be menu or taxonomy.

 Post-Installation 
 Place the menu tree block in your region and config it.
